# origincloud_network_security_group_associations (Data Source)

Lists a network interface's security group associations, oldest first.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_interface` (String) The network interface whose security group associations to list.
- `project` (String) The project whose security group associations to list.
- `zone` (String) The zone whose security group associations to list.

### Read-Only

- `security_group_associations` (Attributes List) The security group associations listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_group_associations))

<a id="nestedatt--security_group_associations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security_group_associations`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The association's resource name. Its last segment is the security group's id.
- `security_group` (String) The security group, in the interface's VPC.
